name: Datarails FinanceOS
description: Datarails FinanceOS connects Claude to your company's consolidated financial data — actuals, budgets, forecasts, and business metrics. Ask questions in plain language and get answers grounded in your live finance tables: discover your org's defined business metrics and check their health, aggregate and filter raw finance tables, profile data quality, look up FX rates and DR.GET Excel functions, and browse your company profile, filebox, and org structure. Built for FP&A teams, controllers, and CFOs who want their numbers at their fingertips. The connector is read-only — it never creates, modifies, or deletes financial data in Datarails.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Datarails FinanceOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Datarails FinanceOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.datarails.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Datarails FinanceOS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Datarails FinanceOS lists 24 MCP tools, including get_aggregation_result_by_alias, get_aggregation_result_by_id, get_company_profile_sections, get_connector_status, get_currency_rates, get_data_by_alias, get_data_by_id, get_distinct_values_result_by_alias, get_distinct_values_result_by_id, get_fields_by_id, get_org_users, and get_workflow_guide.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Datarails FinanceOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Datarails FinanceOS in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Datarails FinanceOS MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Datarails FinanceOS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Datarails FinanceOS is developed by Datarails. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
